Mandai Rainforest Resort by Banyan Tree | Mandai Wildlife Reserve
Mandai Rainforest Resort
by Banyan Tree
Integrated Nature and Wildlife Destination
The Mandai Rainforest Resort by Banyan Tree is nestled within the Mandai Wildlife Reserve, Singapore’s nature and wildlife destination that is home to renowned zoological parks —  Bird Paradise , Night Safari , River Wonders , Singapore Zoo , and Rainforest Wild Adventure  — connecting people to the fascinating world of wildlife through meaningful experiences.
Biophilic design is at the heart of the resort’s architecture, influencing every aspect from programmes to signature amenities and services. Drawing from Banyan Group’s legacy of honouring the essence of each location, the 338-room resort blends seamlessly with its natural surroundings, offering rooms nestled in lush greenery or overlooking the Upper Seletar Reservoir. The unique layers of the rainforest — from the forest floor to the canopy — are reflected in the room designs, celebrating nature’s rich biodiversity.
Guests are encouraged to join in thoughtful sustainability efforts, fostering a lighter environmental footprint throughout their stay.
Embark on a journey of unparalleled experiences. Plan your next getaway.

Frequently Asked Questions
Frequently Asked Questions
Where is Mandai Rainforest Resort by Banyan Tree located?
Mandai Rainforest Resort by Banyan Tree is located within Singapore’s Mandai Wildlife Reserve — a world-leading nature and wildlife destination with direct access to Singapore Zoo , Night Safari , River Wonders , Bird Paradise , and the brand-new Rainforest Wild Adventure .
Convenient and easy access to these popular attractions offers guests immersive wildlife encounters and experiential learning journeys during their stay at the resort.
Does Mandai Rainforest Resort by Banyan Tree offer special packages that include attractions or experiences?
Mandai Rainforest Resort by Banyan Tree offers room packages with admission tickets to the Mandai wildlife parks for an immersive native wildlife exploration.
There are also exclusive experiences available to young resort guests at the parks. Visit Offers for more details.
For inquiries, please contact our reservations team at [email protected] .
Does Mandai Rainforest Resort by Banyan Tree provide any family-friendly facilities?
Mandai Rainforest Resort by Banyan Tree has family rooms with a bunk bed and kids’ corner. Visit Accommodation for more details.
There are also facilities within the resort for young ones. Young guests will enjoy the Rangers' Club indoor space and outdoor playground. There are also thoughtfully designed workshops and educational programmes available.
How do I make a booking at Banyan Tree Spa?
Visit Spa & Wellbeing for more details. For inquiries and booking, contact [email protected] .
Does Mandai Rainforest Resort by Banyan Tree offer on-site parking for guests?
Each guest will be presented with 1 carpark coupon per room per day. Ticket is applicable to all room types. Please approach our Concierge for the carpark tickets and share your room number after checking-in.
Is Mandai Rainforest Resort by Banyan Tree pet-friendly?
We regret to inform you that the resort is not pet-friendly. We understand that pets are an important part of many families, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

Parks Rules and Conditions | Mandai Wildlife Reserve
Homepage
Plan Your Visit
Parks Rules and Conditions
Parks Rules and Conditions
The following rules and conditions apply to all visitors to the Mandai Wildlife Reserve (the " MWR "), which includes areas that require an Admission Ticket or Attraction Ticket (both as defined in the Park Tickets Terms and Conditions and collectively, the " Ticketed Areas ") for their own safety and enjoyment, and that of others.
Respect Wildlife
Respect Wildlife
You may encounter wildlife during your time with us, as the MWR is located next to the Central Catchment Nature Reserve in Singapore.
Such wildlife is not within the care or control of Mandai Wildlife Group (as defined below). Do not attempt to approach, feed, touch, tease or do any act to cause disturbance, annoyance, or injury to both wildlife and our animals.
Maintain a safe distance and appreciate them from afar.
Respect our Animals
Respect our Animals
Any contact with our animals in the MWR for official, entertainment, education, photography, or other authorised purposes shall be provided by or under the supervision of Mandai Wildlife Group.
Smoke-free MWR
Smoke-free MWR
Keep the MWR smoke-free. Smoking is only allowed at designated smoking points.
No Flash Photography or Flashlights
No Flash Photography or Flashlights
Flash photography or flashlights are prohibited to prevent disturbance or annoyance to wildlife, our animals and other visitors.
Use of Active Mobility Devices (AMDs) in the MWR
Use of Active Mobility Devices (AMDs) in the MWR
Personal Mobility Aids (PMAs) are allowed in the MWR.
Please use AMDs, such as the following, only on designated cycling paths around the MWR:
bicycles, tricycles, recumbents;
inline skates, roller-skates;
motorised Personal Mobility Devices (PMDs) (including e-scooters, hoverboards, and motorised luggage); and
non-motorised PMDs (including kick scooters and skateboards).
All other areas in the MWR must be enjoyed on foot to ensure visitor safety and comfort. Please park your AMDs at designated bicycle parking areas.
Keep the MWR Clean
Keep the MWR Clean
Littering is prohibited by law. Please dispose all litter in the bins provided in the MWR.
Access Rules for Dogs (including Assistance Dogs) in the MWR
Access Rules for Dogs (including Assistance Dogs) in the MWR
Dogs (including assistance dogs) are not allowed in Ticketed Areas, the Mandai Boardwalk and Mandai Gallery, to prevent disturbance or annoyance to both wildlife and our animals.
Dogs are allowed in all other non-Ticketed Areas, unless specific signage indicates otherwise.
Please keep all dogs leashed, clean up after them and dispose of all waste in a hygienic manner.
All dog breeds specified under the Animals and Birds (Licensing and Control of Cats and Dogs) Rules must be muzzled.
All pets and service animals other than dogs are not allowed in the MWR.
Respect Plant Life
Respect Plant Life
Please do not pluck, stomp, or damage any plants or climb any trees in the MWR.
No Releasing of Animals
No Releasing of Animals
Please do not release or introduce any animals or plants into the MWR as they may harm our animals and/or the eco-system.
No Kite-flying and Playing of Frisbees or Balls
No Kite-flying and Playing of Frisbees or Balls
The above recreational activities are prohibited in the MWR to ensure visitor safety and comfort.
No Remote-Controlled Aerial Devices
No Remote-Controlled Aerial Devices
Flying of any model aircrafts (including drones), remote-controlled aerial cameras, or other similar devices is prohibited in the MWR to ensure visitor safety and protection of our environment.
No Open Fires
No Open Fires
All forms of open fire, including BBQs and lit candles, are prohibited in the MWR.
No Fishing or Swimming
No Fishing or Swimming
The above recreational activities are prohibited in the MWR to ensure visitor safety and protection of our environment.
No balloons in the Ticketed Areas, Mandai Gallery and the Mandai Boardwalk
No balloons in the Ticketed Areas, Mandai Gallery and the Mandai Boardwalk
Balloons are prohibited in the Ticketed Areas, Mandai Gallery and the Mandai Boardwalk to prevent disturbance or annoyance to wildlife, our animals and other visitors, as well as for the protection of our environment.
Parking in the MWR
Parking in the MWR
Parking is only permitted in designated parking areas within the Mandai Wildlife Reserve. No waiting or parking is allowed along Mandai Lake Road.
Strollers/Prams and PMAs
Strollers/Prams and PMAs
Due to safety reasons, visitors with strollers/prams and/or Personal Mobility Aids (PMAs) should use the lifts instead of escalators when moving around the MWR.
Explore Safely
Explore Safely
Keep to designated or marked walking paths, or trails in the MWR.
Take extra care on pathways that are wet or slippery.
Filming and Photography
Filming and Photography
Prior approval is required for any commercial filming and photography. Please fill this form  and we will get back to you within ten (10) working days.
Park Operations
The MWR shall be open to the public at such days and hours as prescribed by the Mandai Wildlife Group (being Mandai Wildlife Group Pte Ltd. and its subsidiaries, related companies, and affiliates who are engaged in its lines of businesses, as the case may be) (" MWG " or " Mandai Wildlife Group ") and exhibited on notice boards affixed in the MWR or on its websites, and/or other collaterals.
Mandai Wildlife Group may, in its sole and absolute discretion, vary the operating hours of any areas or parks within the MWR, whether wholly or in part, without prior notice or reason.
Mandai Wildlife Group shall not be liable for any delays or cancellation or closure of the MWR or any presentations, animal appearances, restaurants, exhibits, features, or walking paths in or at any part of the MWR resulting from acts or occurrences beyond its control including without limitation to acts of God, regulations, or any governmental authority, war or
